`PUT /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/brand` → `Mail.Brand`

### `mail.broadcasts.audience(params?, options?)`

`GET /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/broadcasts/audience` → `Mail.BroadcastAudience`

Count a broadcast audience.

How many contacts a broadcast to this segment and/or topic would reach if it were sent now: members of the segment, subscribed to the topic, minus anyone unsubscribed or on the suppression list.

- Params: `Mail.BroadcastAudienceParams`

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |

| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | The caller lacks the action this route requires on the resource, or Mail is not enabled for the workspace. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | Workspace not found: no workspace has this `workspaceId`, or it is not a UUID (`NOT_FOUND`). A workspace the caller is not a member of answers 403. Routes that read a resource also answer 404 when the resource is missing. |
| 422 | `UnprocessableEntityError` | `UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY`, `AUDIENCE_REQUIRED`, `SEGMENT_NOT_FOUND`, `TOPIC_NOT_FOUND` | Neither given (`AUDIENCE_REQUIRED`), or one does not exist in this workspace (`SEGMENT_NOT_FOUND` / `TOPIC_NOT_FOUND`). |

### `mail.broadcasts.send(broadcastId, params?, options?)`

`POST /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/broadcasts/{broadcast_id}/send` → `Mail.Broadcast`

Send or schedule a broadcast.

Now, or at `scheduled_at`. When sending starts the audience is frozen (segment ∩ topic subscribers − unsubscribed − suppression list) and the messages go out at the broadcast rate (default 120 per minute; separate from the transactional limit), on the marketing stream, each with a one-click unsubscribe link and `List-Unsubscribe` headers. The send survives restarts: it continues from the recipients not yet sent.

- Params: `Mail.BroadcastSendParams`
- Idempotent: an `Idempotency-Key` is sent automatically and reused on retries

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | A resource id in the path is not a UUID, or the request failed validation (`BAD_REQUEST` / `VALIDATION_ERROR`). |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing, expired or invalid bearer token. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | The caller lacks the action this route requires on the resource, or Mail is not enabled for the workspace. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND`, `BROADCAST_NOT_FOUND` | No such broadcast (`BROADCAST_NOT_FOUND`). |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT`, `BROADCAST_NOT_DRAFT`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`, `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` | Not a draft (`BROADCAST_NOT_DRAFT`), or `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`. Idempotency: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` when this `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route; `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` while another request with the same key is still running (retry after `Retry-After` seconds, with the same key). |
| 422 | `UnprocessableEntityError` | `UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY`, `UNSUBSCRIBE_LINK_REQUIRED`, `BROADCAST_NOT_READY`, `BROADCAST_AUDIENCE_EMPTY`, `INVALID_FROM_ADDRESS`, `from_domain_not_verified` | Not ready: `UNSUBSCRIBE_LINK_REQUIRED` (the body does not contain `{{{unsubscribe_url}}}`) or `BROADCAST_NOT_READY` (`details.problems`: no audience, no content, no subject, missing template, no From); `BROADCAST_AUDIENCE_EMPTY` (nobody to send to); `INVALID_FROM_ADDRESS`; or `from_domain_not_verified` (`details: { fqdn, reason }`). |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const broadcast = await mail.broadcasts.send("3f0c1a2b-4c5d-4e6f-8a9b-0c1d2e3f4a5b", { scheduled_at: "2026-11-02T09:00:00Z" });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/mail/api-reference#post-v1-workspaces-workspace-id-broadcasts-broadcast-id-send)

## contacts.imports

### `mail.contacts.imports.create(params, options?)`

`POST /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/contacts/imports` → `Mail.ContactImport`

Import contacts from a CSV file.

Queues the file and returns the import (`status: queued`); poll `GET .../contacts/imports/{id}` for progress. At most 10 MB and 100,000 rows, two imports running per workspace. Rows that assert consent (`consent` true or a `consented_at` date) are recorded with it and opted in to `topic_ids`; every other row starts without consent. An import emits no per-contact webhook events.

- Params: `Mail.ContactImportCreateParams`
- Idempotent: an `Idempotency-Key` is sent automatically and reused on retries

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | A resource id in the path is not a UUID, or the request failed validation (`BAD_REQUEST` / `VALIDATION_ERROR`). |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing, expired or invalid bearer token. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | The caller lacks the action this route requires on the resource, or Mail is not enabled for the workspace. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND`, `TOPIC_NOT_FOUND` | A `topic_ids` entry is not a topic of this workspace (`TOPIC_NOT_FOUND`). |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT`, `IMPORT_IN_PROGRESS`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`, `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` | Two imports are already running (`IMPORT_IN_PROGRESS`), or `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`: the `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route. Idempotency: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` when this `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route; `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` while another request with the same key is still running (retry after `Retry-After` seconds, with the same key). |
| 413 | `APIError` | `PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE`, `IMPORT_TOO_LARGE` | The CSV is larger than 10 MB (`IMPORT_TOO_LARGE`). |
| 422 | `UnprocessableEntityError` | `UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY`, `INVALID_CSV` | Empty file, or no header line with an `email` column (`INVALID_CSV`). |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const contactImport = await mail.contacts.imports.create({
  csv: "email,first_name,consent,consented_at\nada@example.com,Ada,true,2026-10-01T09:00:00Z\n",
  on_conflict: "upsert",
});
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/mail/api-reference#post-v1-workspaces-workspace-id-contacts-imports)

### `mail.domains.create(params?, options?)`

`POST /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/domains` → `Mail.Domain`

Register a domain for a workspace.

Accepts Resend's create-domain body as well as ours: `name` for `fqdn`, `capabilities` for `intent`, `custom_return_path` for the MAIL FROM label, and `region`, `tls`, `open_tracking`, `click_tracking`, `tracking_subdomain`. Defaults to sending only (`intent: send`), as Resend does. Options we do not offer yet are refused with 422 rather than ignored.

- Params: `Mail.DomainCreateParams`
- Idempotent: an `Idempotency-Key` is sent automatically and reused on retries

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR`, `INVALID_CAPABILITIES`, `MAIL_FROM_NOT_SENDING` | Validation failure on the request body: no `fqdn`/`name`, `fqdn` and `name` disagree, `intent` and `capabilities` disagree or enable nothing (`INVALID_CAPABILITIES`), or `custom_return_path` on a receive-only domain (`MAIL_FROM_NOT_SENDING`). |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing, expired or invalid bearer token. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | The caller lacks the action this route requires on the resource, or Mail is not enabled for the workspace. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | Workspace not found: no workspace has this `workspaceId`, or it is not a UUID (`NOT_FOUND`). A workspace the caller is not a member of answers 403. Routes that read a resource also answer 404 when the resource is missing. |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT`, `MAIL_FROM_HOST_IN_USE`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`, `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` | Domain already registered (globally unique); `MAIL_FROM_HOST_IN_USE`: the `custom_return_path` host already has records that are not ours (listed in `details.found`); or `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`: the `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route. Idempotency: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` when this `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route; `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` while another request with the same key is still running (retry after `Retry-After` seconds, with the same key). |
| 422 | `UnprocessableEntityError` | `UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY`, `REGION_NOT_AVAILABLE`, `TLS_ENFORCED_NOT_AVAILABLE`, `TRACKING_NOT_AVAILABLE` | `REGION_NOT_AVAILABLE`: `region` is not the region this deployment sends from (`details.available`); `TLS_ENFORCED_NOT_AVAILABLE`: `tls: enforced`; `TRACKING_NOT_AVAILABLE`: open/click tracking or a tracking subdomain. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |


### `mail.domains.delete(domainId, options?)`

`DELETE /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/domains/{domain_id}` → `void`

Delete a domain (must have no active mailboxes left).

Permanently deletes the domain, its DNS record set and its Amazon SES sending identity. Mailboxes you already deleted on it are erased with it, together with the mail they still held and its stored files; this cannot be undone. Refused with 409 `DOMAIN_HAS_MAILBOXES` while any mailbox on it is active.

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | A resource id in the path is not a UUID, or the request failed validation (`BAD_REQUEST` / `VALIDATION_ERROR`). |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing, expired or invalid bearer token. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | The caller lacks the action this route requires on the resource, or Mail is not enabled for the workspace. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | Domain not found in this workspace. |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT`, `DOMAIN_HAS_MAILBOXES` | `DOMAIN_HAS_MAILBOXES`: the domain still has active mailboxes. `details.count` is how many; `details.mailboxes` lists them (`id`, `address`, first 100). Delete them, then try again. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |
| 503 | `InternalServerError` | `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`, `SES_IDENTITY_DELETE_FAILED` | `SES_IDENTITY_DELETE_FAILED`: the domain's Amazon SES identity could not be removed. Nothing was deleted; retry. |

```ts
await mail.domains.delete("3f0c1a2b-4c5d-4e6f-8a9b-0c1d2e3f4a5b");
```

### `mail.domains.update(domainId, params?, options?)`

`PATCH /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/domains/{domain_id}` → `Mail.Domain`

Update domain settings: capabilities, DNS provider hint, custom MAIL FROM subdomain, DMARC recommendation.

`intent` (or Resend's `capabilities`) changes what the domain is used for. A pending domain just changes; a verified domain gaining sending or receiving has the new records checked live and is refused with 409 `CAPABILITY_NOT_VERIFIED` (the records to publish in `details.records`) until they pass. Turning receiving off is refused while active mailboxes exist (409 `DOMAIN_HAS_MAILBOXES`, the mailboxes in `details.mailboxes`; deleted mailboxes do not count); turning sending off also turns the custom MAIL FROM off. `tls`, `open_tracking`, `click_tracking` and `tracking_subdomain` are accepted for Resend compatibility; only the values in effect today pass (422 otherwise). `dns_provider` is the provider the setup wizard renders host names for. `mail_from_subdomain` sets the custom MAIL FROM label (`bounce` → `bounce.<fqdn>`; `null` turns it off): the domain's record set gains the MAIL FROM MX + SPF records, and once the domain is verified its MAIL FROM is pointed there (the default return address stays in use until the MX record is found, so mail never stops). Refused with 409 when that host already carries records that are not ours. `dmarc_managed: false` hides the `_dmarc` recommendation for domains whose DMARC is managed elsewhere (the policy is still detected and graded).

- Params: `Mail.DomainUpdateParams`
- Idempotent: an `Idempotency-Key` is sent automatically and reused on retries

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR`, `INVALID_CAPABILITIES`, `MAIL_FROM_NOT_SENDING` | Validation failure on the request body; `intent` and `capabilities` disagree or enable nothing (`INVALID_CAPABILITIES`); or `mail_from_subdomain` on a receive-only domain (`MAIL_FROM_NOT_SENDING`). |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing, expired or invalid bearer token. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | The caller lacks the action this route requires on the resource, or Mail is not enabled for the workspace. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | Domain not found in this workspace. |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT`, `CAPABILITY_NOT_VERIFIED`, `DOMAIN_HAS_MAILBOXES`, `MAIL_FROM_HOST_IN_USE`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`, `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` | `CAPABILITY_NOT_VERIFIED`: a verified domain cannot gain sending or receiving until the new records verify (`details.failing`, `details.records`); `DOMAIN_HAS_MAILBOXES`: receiving cannot be turned off while active mailboxes exist (`details.count`, `details.mailboxes[].id\|address`); `MAIL_FROM_HOST_IN_USE`: the MAIL FROM host already has a CNAME, a foreign MX or a foreign SPF record (listed in `details.found`); or `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`. Idempotency: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` when this `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route; `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` while another request with the same key is still running (retry after `Retry-After` seconds, with the same key). |
| 422 | `UnprocessableEntityError` | `UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY`, `TLS_ENFORCED_NOT_AVAILABLE`, `TRACKING_NOT_AVAILABLE` | `TLS_ENFORCED_NOT_AVAILABLE`: `tls: enforced`; `TRACKING_NOT_AVAILABLE`: open/click tracking or a tracking subdomain. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | `mail_from_subdomain` or `intent` changed less than 10 seconds ago (`RATE_LIMITED`). Per-IP limit: more than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const domain = await mail.domains.update("3f0c1a2b-4c5d-4e6f-8a9b-0c1d2e3f4a5b", { capabilities: { receiving: "enabled", sending: "enabled" } });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/mail/api-reference#patch-v1-workspaces-workspace-id-domains-domain-id)

### `mail.domains.verify(domainId, options?)`

`POST /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/domains/{domain_id}/verify` → `Mail.Domain`

Run a synchronous DNS check against this domain; flips status to active when the required record set passes.

Legacy shape, kept as an alias of `POST .../dns-records/check`: returns the domain on success and a 400 with `dns_check_results` when a required record fails. New integrations should use `POST .../dns-records/check`, which returns per-record states.

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | Verification failed — one or more required records are still missing or wrong. |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing, expired or invalid bearer token. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | The caller lacks the action this route requires on the resource, or Mail is not enabled for the workspace. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | Domain not found in this workspace. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Verified less than 10 seconds ago (`RATE_LIMITED`). Per-IP limit: more than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const domain = await mail.domains.verify("3f0c1a2b-4c5d-4e6f-8a9b-0c1d2e3f4a5b");
```

## domains.dnsRecords

### `mail.domains.dnsRecords.apply(domainId, params, options?)`

`POST /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/domains/{domain_id}/dns-records/apply` → `Mail.DnsApplyResult`

Set up the domain's DNS records in one step with a short-lived Cloudflare or DigitalOcean API token.

Reads the zone through the provider's API and plans every record the domain needs: `create`, `update` (only ever an SPF merge into an existing SPF record, shown with `before`/`after`) or `skip` (already there). `dry_run: true` returns the plan and changes nothing; `dry_run: false` applies exactly that plan, runs a DNS check straight away and records `setup_method = provider_api`. Only names at or under the domain are written, nothing is ever deleted, and Cloudflare records are DNS-only (not proxied). The recommended DMARC record (`p=none`) is included when `include_dmarc` is true (the default) and no DMARC policy applies to the domain yet; an existing policy is never touched. Any blocking conflict refuses the whole apply with 409. The token is used for this request only: it is never stored, logged, queued or returned; revoke it afterwards (`warnings` says so when it could see more than this zone). Applies are limited to one per domain every 10 seconds; dry runs are not limited.

- Params: `Mail.DomainDnsRecordApplyParams`
- Idempotent: an `Idempotency-Key` is sent automatically and reused on retries

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED`, `INVALID_ZONE`, `PROVIDER_TOKEN_REJECTED`, `PROVIDER_PERMISSION_DENIED`, `PROVIDER_ZONE_NOT_FOUND` | Validation failure; `Idempotency-Key` missing (`IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED`); `zone` not the domain or a parent (`INVALID_ZONE`); the provider rejected the token (`PROVIDER_TOKEN_REJECTED`), the token lacks DNS permissions (`PROVIDER_PERMISSION_DENIED`), or it cannot see a zone for the domain (`PROVIDER_ZONE_NOT_FOUND`). |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing, expired or invalid bearer token. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | Missing `mail.update`, or the mail service is not enabled for the workspace. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | Domain not found in this workspace. |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT`, `DNS_CONFLICTS`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`, `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` | `DNS_CONFLICTS`: a blocking conflict (a second SPF record, a CNAME at the name, another DKIM key at our selector, other MX records at the MAIL FROM host or the domain, a merge over 10 SPF lookups). Nothing was written; the body carries the full `plan` and `conflicts`. Or `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`. Idempotency: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` when this `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route; `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` while another request with the same key is still running (retry after `Retry-After` seconds, with the same key). |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Applied less than 10 seconds ago (`RATE_LIMITED`). Per-IP limit: more than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |
| 502 | `InternalServerError` | `BAD_GATEWAY`, `PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE`, `PROVIDER_ERROR` | The provider failed or did not answer (`PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE`, `PROVIDER_ERROR`). Nothing was written unless the plan items say so. |

```ts
const dnsApplyResult = await mail.domains.dnsRecords.apply("3f0c1a2b-4c5d-4e6f-8a9b-0c1d2e3f4a5b", { dry_run: true, provider: "cloudflare", token: "dop_v1_EXAMPLE_TOKEN_DO_NOT_USE" });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/mail/api-reference#post-v1-workspaces-workspace-id-domains-domain-id-dns-records-apply)

### `mail.domains.dnsRecords.check(domainId, params?, options?)`

`POST /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/domains/{domain_id}/dns-records/check` → `Mail.DomainDnsRecords`

Check the domain's DNS records now.

Queries the zone's authoritative nameservers and a public resolver for every record, stores the result, flips a pending domain whose required records pass to `active`, and returns the same body as `GET .../dns-records`. Never fails because records are missing: their states say so. Limited to one call per domain every 10 seconds. Safe to retry: it changes nothing but the stored check result, so it takes no Idempotency-Key.

- Params: `Mail.DomainDnsRecordCheckParams`

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR`, `INVALID_ZONE` | `zone` is not the domain or one of its parents (`INVALID_ZONE`). |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing, expired or invalid bearer token. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | The caller lacks the action this route requires on the resource, or Mail is not enabled for the workspace. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | Domain not found in this workspace. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Checked less than 10 seconds ago (`RATE_LIMITED`). Per-IP limit: more than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const domainDnsRecords = await mail.domains.dnsRecords.check("3f0c1a2b-4c5d-4e6f-8a9b-0c1d2e3f4a5b");
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/mail/api-reference#post-v1-workspaces-workspace-id-domains-domain-id-dns-records-check)

### `mail.domains.dnsRecords.export(domainId, params, options?)`

`GET /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/domains/{domain_id}/dns-records/export` → `Response`

Download the domain's DNS records as a BIND zone fragment or a CSV.

`format=bind`: a zone-file fragment (`$ORIGIN <zone>.`, `$TTL 3600`, names relative to the zone, MX with priority, TXT split into ≤255-byte quoted strings, a comment per record with its purpose, required/recommended and any conflict) that Cloudflare and Route 53 import directly. `format=csv`: `type,name,value,priority,ttl,purpose,required` (the common DNS-import columns plus two), RFC 4180 quoting, fully qualified names. By default only records not yet verified; `all=true` for every record. Served as an attachment.

- Params: `Mail.DomainDnsRecordExportParams`

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | `format` missing or not `bind`/`csv`, or `zone` is not the domain or one of its parents. |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing, expired or invalid bearer token. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | The caller lacks the action this route requires on the resource, or Mail is not enabled for the workspace. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | Domain not found in this workspace. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const response = await mail.domains.dnsRecords.export("3f0c1a2b-4c5d-4e6f-8a9b-0c1d2e3f4a5b", { format: "bind" });
const text = await response.text();
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/mail/api-reference#get-v1-workspaces-workspace-id-domains-domain-id-dns-records-export)

### `mail.domains.dnsRecords.list(domainId, params?, options?)`

`GET /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/domains/{domain_id}/dns-records` → `Mail.DomainDnsRecords`

Per-record DNS status for a domain.

Every record the domain needs for its intent, with its state (`missing`, `mismatch`, `conflict`, `propagating`, `verified`), what was found, a propagation hint and timestamps, as of the last check (the verifier re-checks pending domains every 5 minutes and active ones hourly). Does not run a DNS lookup; use `POST .../dns-records/check` for that.

| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing, expired or invalid bearer token. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | The caller lacks the action this route requires on the resource, or Mail is not enabled for the workspace. |

| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const domainDnsRecords = await mail.domains.dnsRecords.list("3f0c1a2b-4c5d-4e6f-8a9b-0c1d2e3f4a5b");
```

## domains.domainConnect

### `mail.domains.domainConnect.start(domainId, params?, options?)`

`POST /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/domains/{domain_id}/domain-connect/start` → `Mail.DomainConnectStart`

Start one-click DNS setup at the domain's DNS provider (Domain Connect).

Returns a signed Domain Connect URL for the provider that hosts the domain's zone (Cloudflare, GoDaddy, IONOS, Vercel and the others that have onboarded ProductCraft's template). Open it in the browser: the user signs in at their provider and confirms, the provider writes the DKIM key at `productcraft._domainkey.<domain>` and the MAIL FROM records at `bounce.<domain>` (MX to the regional feedback host, SPF merged into any existing SPF there), and then redirects to `GET /v1/domain-connect/callback`, which records `setup_method = domain_connect`, checks the records and returns the user to the domain in the console. With `include_dmarc` and no DMARC policy in place yet, a second confirmation adds `v=DMARC1; p=none;` at `_dmarc.<domain>`. The URL is valid for 10 minutes and works once. ProductCraft never receives a DNS credential. For sending domains whose MAIL FROM label is `bounce` (the default). Not available while ProductCraft has Domain Connect switched off (`domain_connect.available` in `GET .../domains/lookup` says whether it is).

- Params: `Mail.DomainDomainConnectStartParams`
- Idempotent: an `Idempotency-Key` is sent automatically and reused on retries

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | Validation failure, or an id is not a UUID. |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing, expired or invalid bearer token. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | Missing `mail.update`, or the mail service is not enabled for the workspace. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | Domain not found in this workspace. |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT`, `DOMAIN_CONNECT_DISABLED`, `DOMAIN_CONNECT_UNAVAILABLE`, `DOMAIN_CONNECT_NOT_SENDING`, `DOMAIN_CONNECT_MAIL_FROM_LABEL`, `DKIM_KEY_MISSING`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`, `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` | One-click setup is not possible for this domain; nothing was started. `DOMAIN_CONNECT_DISABLED`: ProductCraft has not switched Domain Connect on. `DOMAIN_CONNECT_UNAVAILABLE`: the DNS provider does not run Domain Connect or has not onboarded our template (`details.reason`: `no_record`, `settings_unreachable`, `template_not_onboarded` or `lookup_failed`; `details.provider_name`). `DOMAIN_CONNECT_NOT_SENDING`: a receive-only domain. `DOMAIN_CONNECT_MAIL_FROM_LABEL`: the MAIL FROM label is not `bounce` or MAIL FROM is off. `DKIM_KEY_MISSING`: no DKIM key to publish. Or `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`. Idempotency: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` when this `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route; `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` while another request with the same key is still running (retry after `Retry-After` seconds, with the same key). |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const domainConnectStart = await mail.domains.domainConnect.start("3f0c1a2b-4c5d-4e6f-8a9b-0c1d2e3f4a5b", { include_dmarc: true });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/mail/api-reference#post-v1-workspaces-workspace-id-domains-domain-id-domain-connect-start)

## domains.shareLinks

### `mail.domains.shareLinks.create(domainId, params?, options?)`

`POST /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/domains/{domain_id}/share-links` → `Mail.CreatedShareLink`

Create a share link: a read-only DNS setup page for whoever manages the domain's DNS.

Returns a link (valid 1–7 days, default 7) to a public page that shows the domain name, its DNS records with copy-ready values, their live status and zone-file / CSV downloads, without an account. The page shows nothing else about the workspace. The link is shown only in this response (only its hash is stored); revoke it with `DELETE .../share-links/{link_id}`. Optionally emails it from ProductCraft to up to 5 recipients per domain per day (20 per workspace). Requires `mail.update` on the domain.

- Params: `Mail.DomainShareLinkCreateParams`
- Idempotent: an `Idempotency-Key` is sent automatically and reused on retries

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | Validation failure: `expires_in_days` outside 1–7, more than 5 `email_to` entries, or an invalid address. |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing, expired or invalid bearer token. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | The caller lacks the action this route requires on the resource, or Mail is not enabled for the workspace. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | Domain not found in this workspace. |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`, `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` | `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`: the key was used with a different body. Idempotency: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` when this `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route; `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` while another request with the same key is still running (retry after `Retry-After` seconds, with the same key). |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | The daily email cap for the domain (5 recipients) or the workspace (20) would be exceeded (`RATE_LIMITED`). No link is created. Per-IP limit: more than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |
| 503 | `InternalServerError` | `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`, `EMAIL_UNAVAILABLE` | `EMAIL_UNAVAILABLE`: `email_to` was given but the email cap cannot be checked right now. No link is created; retry, or create it without `email_to`. |

```ts
const createdShareLink = await mail.domains.shareLinks.create("3f0c1a2b-4c5d-4e6f-8a9b-0c1d2e3f4a5b", { email_to: ["it@example.com"] });
```

## emails

### `mail.emails.batch(params, options?)`

`POST /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/emails/batch` → `Mail.SendBatchOpenApi`

Send up to 100 emails in one request.

Each row is a `POST /emails` body plus an optional `idempotency_key`, processed independently: the response reports `accepted` (with the email `id`) or `rejected` (with `error.code`) per row. An `Idempotency-Key` header covers the whole request; a row `idempotency_key` covers one row, in the same dedupe namespace (so the header must differ from every row key).

- Params: `Mail.EmailBatchParams`
- Idempotent: an `Idempotency-Key` is sent automatically and reused on retries

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_CONFLICTS_WITH_ROW` | Validation failure (malformed row, more than 100 rows), or `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_CONFLICTS_WITH_ROW`: the `Idempotency-Key` header equals a row `idempotency_key`. |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing, expired or invalid bearer token. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | The caller lacks the action this route requires on the resource, or Mail is not enabled for the workspace. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | Workspace not found: no workspace has this `workspaceId`, or it is not a UUID (`NOT_FOUND`). A workspace the caller is not a member of answers 403. Routes that read a resource also answer 404 when the resource is missing. |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`, `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` | `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`: the `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different request body or on a different route. Idempotency: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` when this `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route; `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` while another request with the same key is still running (retry after `Retry-After` seconds, with the same key). |
| 422 | `UnprocessableEntityError` | `UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY`, `from_domain_not_verified`, `domain_not_verified_by_provider`, `INVALID_FROM_ADDRESS` | For any row: `from_domain_not_verified` (body `code`, `details: { fqdn, reason }`): the domain of the From address is not itself an active sending domain of this workspace (`reason: not_registered` or `not_verified`); refused before anything is recorded or queued. Or `domain_not_verified_by_provider`: the from-domain's DNS records have been broken for over 72 h, so the email provider no longer sends for it. Or `INVALID_FROM_ADDRESS`. The whole batch is refused; no row is sent. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | The workspace send limits never 429 a batch: a row over one is rejected in the 200 body with `RATE_LIMITED`, and the other rows are unaffected. Per-IP limit: more than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const sendBatchOpenApi = await mail.emails.batch({
  emails: [{ from: "Acme <hello@mail.acme.com>", to: ["success@simulator.amazonses.com"] }],
});
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/mail/api-reference#post-v1-workspaces-workspace-id-emails-batch)

### `mail.emails.list(params?, options?)`

`GET /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/emails` → `PagePromise<Mail.Email>`

List emails.

One entry per email (send call), newest first, with its recipients and `last_event`, the worst status across its messages. Filter by tags with `tag[name]=value` (repeat for several; all must match). Emails sent before 2026-11-06 appear as one-recipient emails.

- Params: `Mail.EmailListParams`
- Paginated: `for await` iterates every item; `await` gives one page

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | Invalid cursor or tag filter. |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing, expired or invalid bearer token. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | The caller lacks the action this route requires on the resource, or Mail is not enabled for the workspace. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | Workspace not found: no workspace has this `workspaceId`, or it is not a UUID (`NOT_FOUND`). A workspace the caller is not a member of answers 403. Routes that read a resource also answer 404 when the resource is missing. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
for await (const email of mail.emails.list()) {
  console.log(email);
}
const page = await mail.emails.list({}, { timeout: 5_000 });
```

### `mail.emails.metrics(params?, options?)`

`GET /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/emails/metrics` → `Mail.EmailMetrics`

Email metrics for a workspace.

Outbound email counts and rates over a range of up to 30 days, in hourly or daily buckets in your time zone, optionally per sending domain, filtered by domain, API key or source. Read-only.

- **Emails** (`sent`): messages that left the queue.
- **Deliverability rate**: delivered / emails sent with delivery tracking. Emails sent before delivery tracking started, or through a custom SMTP relay, are confirmed at hand-off only, so for them `delivered` is not measured and the rate is `null` (`measured.delivery = false`), never 0.
- **Bounce rate**: bounced / emails. Suppressed recipients never count.
- **Complaint rate**: complained / delivered, from mailbox providers' feedback loops.

Rates are numbers from 0 to 1, or `null` when unmeasured or when the denominator is zero. Template test sends are excluded. Cached for up to 60 seconds.

- Params: `Mail.EmailMetricsParams`

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | A parameter is invalid: `domain_id` or `api_key_id` is not a UUID; more than 100 `domain_id`; an unknown `timezone`, `granularity`, `source` or dimension; a date that does not parse; `end_date` not after `start_date`; a range longer than 30 days or starting before the 30-day retention; or `granularity=hourly` over more than 7 days. The reason is in `message`. |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | No valid credential. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN`, `SERVICE_NOT_ENABLED` | Caller lacks `mail.message.read` on the workspace (including non-members), or Mail is not enabled on it (`SERVICE_NOT_ENABLED`). |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | Workspace not found: no workspace has this `workspaceId`, or it is not a UUID (`NOT_FOUND`). A workspace the caller is not a member of answers 403. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const emailMetrics = await mail.emails.metrics();
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/mail/api-reference#get-v1-workspaces-workspace-id-emails-metrics)

### `mail.emails.send(params, options?)`

`POST /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/emails` → `Mail.SendEmail`

Send an email.

Send your own `html` and/or `text`, or a saved `template`, to up to 50 recipients across `to`, `cc` and `bcc`, with `reply_to`, custom `headers` and `tags`. Every recipient gets its own copy (its own message in `GET /messages`, suppression check and delivery status) showing the same `To` and `Cc` headers; `bcc` recipients appear in no header. A recipient on the suppression list (or unsubscribed, for a template with an unsubscribe link) is left out with a `suppressed` message, and the email is still accepted. Counts one send per recipient against the workspace limits. Pass an `Idempotency-Key` header to make retries safe.

- Params: `Mail.EmailSendParams`
- Idempotent: an `Idempotency-Key` is sent automatically and reused on retries

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR`, `EMAIL_CONTENT_CONFLICT`, `RECIPIENT_LIMIT`, `MAIL_HEADER_NOT_ALLOWED` | Validation failure; `EMAIL_CONTENT_CONFLICT` (both or neither of `html`/`text` and `template`); `RECIPIENT_LIMIT` (more than 50 recipients); `MAIL_HEADER_NOT_ALLOWED` (`details.headers` names the refused headers). |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing, expired or invalid bearer token. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | The caller lacks the action this route requires on the resource, or Mail is not enabled for the workspace. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND`, `TEMPLATE_NOT_FOUND` | `TEMPLATE_NOT_FOUND`: the `template.name` is not a template of this workspace. |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`, `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` | `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`: the `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different request body or on a different route. Idempotency: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` when this `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route; `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` while another request with the same key is still running (retry after `Retry-After` seconds, with the same key). |
| 422 | `UnprocessableEntityError` | `UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY`, `from_domain_not_verified`, `domain_not_verified_by_provider`, `INVALID_FROM_ADDRESS`, `TEMPLATE_RENDER_FAILED`, `TEMPLATE_DATA_INVALID` | `from_domain_not_verified` (body `code`, `details: { fqdn, reason }`): the domain of the From address is not itself an active sending domain of this workspace (`reason: not_registered` or `not_verified`); refused before anything is recorded or queued. Or `domain_not_verified_by_provider`: the from-domain's DNS records have been broken for over 72 h, so the email provider no longer sends for it. Or `INVALID_FROM_ADDRESS`. Or `TEMPLATE_RENDER_FAILED` / `TEMPLATE_DATA_INVALID` for a template send. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Over a workspace send limit (60 per minute, 600 per hour, 10,000 per day; each recipient counts): `RATE_LIMITED` with `details: { window, limit, retry_after }`. Nothing is recorded or queued. Per-IP limit: more than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const sendEmail = await mail.emails.send({ from: "Acme <hello@mail.acme.com>", to: ["success@simulator.amazonses.com"] });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/mail/api-reference#post-v1-workspaces-workspace-id-emails)

## mailboxes

### `mail.mailboxes.create(params, options?)`

`POST /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/mailboxes` → `Mail.Mailbox`

Create a mailbox under a verified domain. Local-part + domain combination must be globally unique.

- Params: `Mail.MailboxCreateParams`
- Idempotent: an `Idempotency-Key` is sent automatically and reused on retries

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | Validation failure (invalid local part, retention out of range). |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing, expired or invalid bearer token. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | Caller lacks `mail.create` permission, or workspace has not enabled the `mail` service. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | Domain not found in this workspace. |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`, `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` | Mailbox local-part already exists on this domain, or the domain is not yet verified, or `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`: the `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route. Idempotency: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` when this `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route; `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` while another request with the same key is still running (retry after `Retry-After` seconds, with the same key). |
| 422 | `UnprocessableEntityError` | `UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY` | Local part or retention rejected by service-layer validation. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const mailbox = await mail.mailboxes.create({ domain_id: "9b2f6c1e-0d6a-4a63-9a43-2f1c3e4d5a6b", local_part: "claude-qa-alpha" });
```

### `mail.mailboxes.delete(id, options?)`

`DELETE /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/mailboxes/{id}` → `void`

Soft-delete a mailbox: its status becomes `disabled` and it stops accepting new mail; existing messages are kept until retention purges them, and `PATCH` with `status: active` restores it. A deleted mailbox no longer blocks deleting its domain, and deleting the domain erases it and its remaining mail.

| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | A resource id in the path is not a UUID, or the request failed validation (`BAD_REQUEST` / `VALIDATION_ERROR`). |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing, expired or invalid bearer token. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | The caller lacks the action this route requires on the resource, or Mail is not enabled for the workspace. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | Mailbox not found in this workspace. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
await mail.mailboxes.delete("3f0c1a2b-4c5d-4e6f-8a9b-0c1d2e3f4a5b");
```

### `mail.messages.erase(params, options?)`

`DELETE /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/messages` → `Mail.DeleteByRecipient`

RTBF: delete every message log row for `recipient` (case-insensitive). Returns the deleted-row count.

The bulk GDPR erase (`messages.erase` in the SDKs): removes every delivery-log row sent to one recipient address in this workspace (with its stored body and events), and strips the address from the cc, bcc and reply-to lists of other rows, in one transaction. Repeating it is harmless (the second call deletes 0 rows).

- Params: `Mail.MessageEraseParams`

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | Missing or invalid recipient. |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing, expired or invalid bearer token. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | The caller lacks the action this route requires on the resource, or Mail is not enabled for the workspace. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | Workspace not found: no workspace has this `workspaceId`, or it is not a UUID (`NOT_FOUND`). A workspace the caller is not a member of answers 403. Routes that read a resource also answer 404 when the resource is missing. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const deleteByRecipient = await mail.messages.erase({ recipient: "ada@example.com" });
```

### `mail.messages.export(params?, options?)`

`GET /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/messages/export` → `Response`

Stream the filtered message log as CSV. Same filters as GET /messages. Body columns are intentionally omitted; bodies remain gated by `mail.message.body.read`. Rate-limited 1 concurrent + 5/hour per workspace.

Columns: id, created_at, sent_at, delivered_at, deferred_at, deferral_count, from_address, to_address, subject, template_name, status, spf_result, dkim_result, dmarc_result, bounce_code, bounce_detail, api_key_id, source, domain. The filters are resolved by the same code as `GET /messages`, so the same query string exports exactly the rows the list pages through. A rejected filter (400) does not count against the hourly cap.

- Params: `Mail.MessageExportParams`

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | Invalid filter: an unknown status or source, a malformed uuid or date-time, `q` over 200 characters, `created_after` not earlier than `created_before`, or a window wider than 30 days. The reason is in `message`. |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing, expired or invalid bearer token. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | The caller lacks the action this route requires on the resource, or Mail is not enabled for the workspace. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | Workspace not found: no workspace has this `workspaceId`, or it is not a UUID (`NOT_FOUND`). A workspace the caller is not a member of answers 403. Routes that read a resource also answer 404 when the resource is missing. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Another export is already running, or this workspace has hit the hourly export cap. Per-IP limit: more than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const response = await mail.messages.export();
const text = await response.text();
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/mail/api-reference#get-v1-workspaces-workspace-id-messages-export)

List outbound messages with cursor pagination.

One row per recipient delivery, newest first. Filters combine with AND: `q` (free text over recipient, from, subject, message id and Message-ID), `status` (any of, repeatable), `domain_id`, `api_key_id`, `source`, `template`, `created_after` / `created_before` (at most 30 days apart), plus the legacy `recipient` and `subject_contains`. `GET /messages/export` takes exactly the same filters and returns the same rows.

`GET /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/messages/timeline` → `Mail.MessageTimeline`

Counts INBOUND mail only: messages received by the workspace's mailboxes, in dense day buckets in [since, until). `metric=sent` (default, a historical name) counts received messages, not outbound sends; `metric=bounced` counts MX-time rejections matched to this workspace by envelope-to. For outbound counts and rates use `GET /emails/metrics`.

- Params: `Mail.MessageTimelineParams`

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | A resource id in the path is not a UUID, or the request failed validation (`BAD_REQUEST` / `VALIDATION_ERROR`). |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing, expired or invalid bearer token. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | The caller lacks the action this route requires on the resource, or Mail is not enabled for the workspace. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | Workspace not found: no workspace has this `workspaceId`, or it is not a UUID (`NOT_FOUND`). A workspace the caller is not a member of answers 403. Routes that read a resource also answer 404 when the resource is missing. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const messageTimeline = await mail.messages.timeline({ granularity: "day", since: "2026-04-01T00:00:00Z", until: "2026-05-01T00:00:00Z" });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/mail/api-reference#get-v1-workspaces-workspace-id-messages-timeline)

```ts
await mail.received.delete("3f0c1a2b-4c5d-4e6f-8a9b-0c1d2e3f4a5b");
```

### `mail.received.export(params?, options?)`

`GET /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/received/export` → `Response`

Stream the filtered received email as CSV. Same filters as GET /received. Rate-limited 1 concurrent + 5/hour per workspace.

Columns: id, received_at, mailbox, from, to (`; `-separated), subject, spam_verdict, spf, dkim, dmarc, size_bytes, attachments (count). No body content. A cell starting with `=`, `+`, `-` or `@` is prefixed with `'` so a spreadsheet does not run it as a formula. A rejected filter (400) does not count against the hourly cap, which is separate from the sent-email export's.

- Params: `Mail.ReceivedExportParams`

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | Invalid filter or cursor: a malformed uuid, boolean or date-time, `q` over 200 characters, `received_after` not earlier than `received_before`, or a window wider than 30 days. The reason is in `message`. |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing, expired or invalid bearer token. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | The policy does not grant `mail.list` on every mailbox, or Mail is not enabled for this workspace. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | Workspace not found: no workspace has this `workspaceId`, or it is not a UUID (`NOT_FOUND`). A workspace the caller is not a member of answers 403. Routes that read a resource also answer 404 when the resource is missing. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Another received-email export is already running, or this workspace has hit the hourly cap (5). Per-IP limit: more than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const response = await mail.received.export();
const text = await response.text();
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/mail/api-reference#get-v1-workspaces-workspace-id-received-export)

### `mail.received.list(params?, options?)`

`GET /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/received` → `PagePromise<Mail.ReceivedEmail>`

List received email across every mailbox in the workspace.

Newest first, cursor-paged, deleted email excluded. Filters combine with AND: `q` (sender, subject, envelope recipient or To address as a substring; or an exact id or Message-ID), `mailbox_id`, `domain_id`, `received_after` / `received_before` (at most 30 days apart), `spam`, `unread`. `GET /received/export` takes exactly the same filters and returns the same rows. No body content.

- Params: `Mail.ReceivedListParams`
- Paginated: `for await` iterates every item; `await` gives one page

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | Invalid filter or cursor: a malformed uuid, boolean or date-time, `q` over 200 characters, `received_after` not earlier than `received_before`, or a window wider than 30 days. The reason is in `message`. |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing, expired or invalid bearer token. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | The policy does not grant `mail.list` on every mailbox, or Mail is not enabled for this workspace. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | Workspace not found: no workspace has this `workspaceId`, or it is not a UUID (`NOT_FOUND`). A workspace the caller is not a member of answers 403. Routes that read a resource also answer 404 when the resource is missing. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
for await (const received of mail.received.list()) {
  console.log(received);
}
const page = await mail.received.list({}, { timeout: 5_000 });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/mail/api-reference#get-v1-workspaces-workspace-id-received)

## segments

### `mail.segments.create(params, options?)`

`POST /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/segments` → `Mail.Segment`

Create a segment.

Without `rule`, a static segment: add and remove contacts one at a time. With `rule`, a rule segment: its members are the contacts whose fields and properties match, evaluated every time it is read. At most 100 segments per workspace.

- Params: `Mail.SegmentCreateParams`
- Idempotent: an `Idempotency-Key` is sent automatically and reused on retries

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | A resource id in the path is not a UUID, or the request failed validation (`BAD_REQUEST` / `VALIDATION_ERROR`). |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing, expired or invalid bearer token. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | The caller lacks the action this route requires on the resource, or Mail is not enabled for the workspace. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | Workspace not found: no workspace has this `workspaceId`, or it is not a UUID (`NOT_FOUND`). A workspace the caller is not a member of answers 403. Routes that read a resource also answer 404 when the resource is missing. |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT`, `SEGMENT_EXISTS`, `SEGMENT_LIMIT`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`, `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` | A segment with this name exists (`SEGMENT_EXISTS`), the workspace has 100 segments (`SEGMENT_LIMIT`), or `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`. Idempotency: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` when this `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route; `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` while another request with the same key is still running (retry after `Retry-After` seconds, with the same key). |
| 422 | `UnprocessableEntityError` | `UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY`, `INVALID_SEGMENT_RULE` | The rule is invalid (`INVALID_SEGMENT_RULE`; `details.problems` lists each one with its condition index): an unknown field, `contains` on a number property, a missing or mistyped `value`, a `value` on `exists`. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const segment = await mail.segments.create({ name: "Pro customers" });
```

### `mail.sendingDefaults.update(params, options?)`

`PUT /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/sending-defaults` → `Mail.SendingDefaults`

| 422 | `UnprocessableEntityError` | `UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY`, `sender_domain_not_in_workspace`, `INVALID_FROM_ADDRESS` | `sender_domain_not_in_workspace` (`details: { fqdn }`): the address is not on a sending domain of this workspace (unknown, another workspace's, or receive-only). `INVALID_FROM_ADDRESS`: the address could not be parsed. |

## stats

### `mail.stats.retrieve(params?, options?)`

`GET /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/stats` → `Mail.MailWorkspaceStats`

Mail stats for a workspace.

Outbound sent, delivered, bounced, complained, deferred, suppressed and unconfirmed counts in the window, the deliverability, bounce and complaint rates, domain totals, the last send time and a daily sent series. For ranges, buckets, filters and a per-domain breakdown use `GET /emails/metrics`; the rates here use its definitions.

`delivered` means the recipient's mail server confirmed the message; `unconfirmed` means the message was handed off and nothing came back either way, which is not the same as delivered. Days are UTC. Rates are 0 to 1, or null when not measured: delivery and complaints are only reported for mail with delivery tracking. Outbound messages are kept for 30 days, so 30d is the longest window. Cached for up to 60 seconds (`generated_at`).

- Params: `Mail.StatsRetrieveParams`

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | `window` is not one of 1d, 7d, 30d. |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing, expired or invalid bearer token. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN`, `SERVICE_NOT_ENABLED` | Caller lacks `mail.message.read` on the workspace (including non-members), or Mail is not enabled on it (`SERVICE_NOT_ENABLED`). |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | Workspace not found: no workspace has this `workspaceId`, or it is not a UUID (`NOT_FOUND`). A workspace the caller is not a member of answers 403. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const mailWorkspaceStats = await mail.stats.retrieve();
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/mail/api-reference#get-v1-workspaces-workspace-id-stats)

| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing, expired or invalid bearer token. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | The caller lacks the action this route requires on the resource, or Mail is not enabled for the workspace. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | Workspace not found: no workspace has this `workspaceId`, or it is not a UUID (`NOT_FOUND`). A workspace the caller is not a member of answers 403. Routes that read a resource also answer 404 when the resource is missing. |
| 422 | `UnprocessableEntityError` | `UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY` | Render failed (compile or runtime error). |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |


### `mail.templates.send(name, params, options?)`

`POST /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/templates/{name}/send` → `Mail.SendAccepted`

Send a template-rendered message. Pass an `Idempotency-Key` header (1..256 chars, [A-Za-z0-9_\-:]) to make retries safe — replays return the original response with `Idempotent-Replay: true` for 24h. Same key + different request body returns 409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE.

- Params: `Mail.TemplateSendParams`
- Idempotent: an `Idempotency-Key` is sent automatically and reused on retries

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | Validation failure (malformed body or recipient). |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing, expired or invalid bearer token. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | The caller lacks the action this route requires on the resource, or Mail is not enabled for the workspace. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | Template not found in this workspace. |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`, `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` | IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE — same key, different body. Idempotency: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` when this `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route; `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` while another request with the same key is still running (retry after `Retry-After` seconds, with the same key). |
| 422 | `UnprocessableEntityError` | `UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY`, `RECIPIENT_SUPPRESSED`, `TOPIC_NOT_FOUND`, `from_domain_not_verified`, `domain_not_verified_by_provider`, `no_default_sender` | Recipient suppressed (`RECIPIENT_SUPPRESSED`; with a `topic_id`, or a template rendering `{{{unsubscribe_url}}}`, also when the recipient unsubscribed or never opted in: `details.reason` is `unsubscribe` or `no_consent`), `TOPIC_NOT_FOUND`, render failure, or invalid from address; or `from_domain_not_verified` (body `code`, `details: { fqdn, reason }`): the domain of the From address is not itself an active sending domain of this workspace — `reason: not_registered` (unknown, registered to another workspace, or only a subdomain such as `mail.example.com` is verified; a verified subdomain does not cover its parent) or `reason: not_verified` (registered, DNS not verified yet). Refused before anything is recorded or queued; or `domain_not_verified_by_provider` (body `code`): the from-domain's DNS records have been broken for over 72 h (`health: failing`), so the email provider no longer sends for it; or `no_default_sender` (body `code`): the body has no `from` and the workspace has no default sender set (nothing is queued; an `email.skipped` webhook event is logged). |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Over a workspace send limit (60 per minute, 600 per hour, 10,000 per day): `RATE_LIMITED` with `details: { window, limit, retry_after }`. Nothing is recorded or queued. Per-IP limit: more than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const sendAccepted = await mail.templates.send("name", { data: { name: "Alice", order_id: "ord_123" }, to: "user@example.com" });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/mail/api-reference#post-v1-workspaces-workspace-id-templates-name-send)

### `mail.templates.sendBatch(name, params, options?)`

`POST /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/templates/{name}/send-batch` → `Mail.SendBatchOpenApi`

Send up to 100 messages with the same template in one request. Per-row partial-success: each row carries its own status (`accepted` | `rejected`).

Two ways to make retries safe. An `Idempotency-Key` header covers the whole request: a retry with the same key and body within 24 h returns the first response (with `Idempotent-Replay: true`) and sends nothing. A per-row `idempotency_key` covers one message: a later batch, or a `/send`, that repeats a row key replays that row instead of sending it again. Both share one dedupe namespace, so the header key must differ from every row key (400 otherwise).

- Params: `Mail.TemplateSendBatchParams`
- Idempotent: an `Idempotency-Key` is sent automatically and reused on retries

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_CONFLICTS_WITH_ROW` | Validation failure (malformed body, batch too large), or the `Idempotency-Key` header equals a row `idempotency_key` (`IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_CONFLICTS_WITH_ROW`). |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing, expired or invalid bearer token. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | The caller lacks the action this route requires on the resource, or Mail is not enabled for the workspace. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | Template not found in this workspace. |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`, `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` | `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`: the `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different request body or on a different route. Idempotency: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` when this `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route; `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` while another request with the same key is still running (retry after `Retry-After` seconds, with the same key). |
| 422 | `UnprocessableEntityError` | `UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY`, `from_domain_not_verified`, `domain_not_verified_by_provider` | For any row: `from_domain_not_verified` (body `code`, `details: { fqdn, reason }`): the domain of the From address is not itself an active sending domain of this workspace — `reason: not_registered` (unknown, registered to another workspace, or only a subdomain such as `mail.example.com` is verified; a verified subdomain does not cover its parent) or `reason: not_verified` (registered, DNS not verified yet). Refused before anything is recorded or queued (the whole batch is refused); or `domain_not_verified_by_provider` (body `code`): the from-domain's DNS records have been broken for over 72 h (`health: failing`), so the email provider no longer sends for it. The whole batch is refused; no row is sent. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | The workspace send limits (60 per minute, 600 per hour, 10,000 per day) never 429 a batch: a row over one is rejected in the 200 body with `RATE_LIMITED`, and the other rows are unaffected. Per-IP limit: more than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const sendBatchOpenApi = await mail.templates.sendBatch("name", {
  messages: [
    {
      data: { code: "A1B2C3", name: "Alice" },
      from: "Acme <noreply@acme.com>",
      to: "alice@example.com",
    },
  ],
});
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/mail/api-reference#post-v1-workspaces-workspace-id-templates-name-send-batch)

- Params: `Mail.TemplateTestSendParams`
- Idempotent: an `Idempotency-Key` is sent automatically and reused on retries

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | A resource id in the path is not a UUID, or the request failed validation (`BAD_REQUEST` / `VALIDATION_ERROR`). |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing, expired or invalid bearer token. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | From-address domain is not registered to this workspace. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | Template not found in this workspace. |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`, `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` | Cannot test-send a layout/partial, or `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`: the `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route. Idempotency: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` when this `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route; `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` while another request with the same key is still running (retry after `Retry-After` seconds, with the same key). |
| 422 | `UnprocessableEntityError` | `UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY`, `from_domain_not_verified`, `domain_not_verified_by_provider` | Invalid from address or render failure; or `from_domain_not_verified` (body `code`, `details: { fqdn, reason }`): the domain of the From address is not itself an active sending domain of this workspace — `reason: not_registered` (unknown, registered to another workspace, or only a subdomain such as `mail.example.com` is verified; a verified subdomain does not cover its parent) or `reason: not_verified` (registered, DNS not verified yet). Refused before anything is recorded or queued; or `domain_not_verified_by_provider` (body `code`): the from-domain's DNS records have been broken for over 72 h (`health: failing`), so the email provider no longer sends for it. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 30 test sends this hour in this workspace: `RATE_LIMITED` with `details: { window, limit, retry_after }`. Per-IP limit: more than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const sendAccepted = await mail.templates.testSend("name", { from: "Acme <hello@acme.com>", to: "ada@example.com" });
```

Send on a topic with `topic_id` on a template send. Recipients manage their topics on the hosted unsubscribe page. At most 50 topics per workspace.

- Params: `Mail.TopicCreateParams`
- Idempotent: an `Idempotency-Key` is sent automatically and reused on retries

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | A resource id in the path is not a UUID, or the request failed validation (`BAD_REQUEST` / `VALIDATION_ERROR`). |

| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT`, `TOPIC_EXISTS`, `TOPIC_LIMIT`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`, `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` | A topic with this name exists (`TOPIC_EXISTS`), the workspace has 50 topics (`TOPIC_LIMIT`), or `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`. ## webhooks.endpoints

### `mail.webhooks.endpoints.create(params, options?)`

`POST /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/webhooks/endpoints` → `Mail.WebhookEndpointWithSecret`

Add a webhook endpoint. Returns its signing secret once.

Deliveries are signed with the Standard Webhooks headers `webhook-id`, `webhook-timestamp` and `webhook-signature` (`v1,<base64 HMAC-SHA256 of "<id>.<timestamp>.<body>">`); the returned `whsec_…` secret works unchanged with any Standard Webhooks library. Failed deliveries are retried after 1 min, 5 min, 30 min, 2 h, 6 h and 24 h.

- Params: `Mail.WebhookEndpointCreateParams`
- Idempotent: an `Idempotency-Key` is sent automatically and reused on retries

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR`, `WEBHOOK_EVENT_TYPE_UNKNOWN` | Validation failure: URL not https with a public host, or an unknown event type (`WEBHOOK_EVENT_TYPE_UNKNOWN`). |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing, expired or invalid bearer token. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | The caller lacks the action this route requires on the resource, or Mail is not enabled for the workspace. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | Workspace not found: no workspace has this `workspaceId`, or it is not a UUID (`NOT_FOUND`). A workspace the caller is not a member of answers 403. Routes that read a resource also answer 404 when the resource is missing. |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT`, `WEBHOOK_ENDPOINT_LIMIT`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`, `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` | Already 10 endpoints (`WEBHOOK_ENDPOINT_LIMIT`), or Idempotency-Key reused with a different body (`IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`). Idempotency: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` when this `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route; `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` while another request with the same key is still running (retry after `Retry-After` seconds, with the same key). |
| 422 | `UnprocessableEntityError` | `UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY` | The URL points at a private, loopback or internal address. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const webhookEndpointWithSecret = await mail.webhooks.endpoints.create({ url: "https://api.acme.com/webhooks" });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/mail/api-reference#post-v1-workspaces-workspace-id-webhooks-endpoints)

| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
await mail.webhooks.endpoints.delete("3f0c1a2b-4c5d-4e6f-8a9b-0c1d2e3f4a5b");
```

| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

### `mail.webhooks.endpoints.rotateSecret(endpointId, params?, options?)`

`POST /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/webhooks/endpoints/{endpoint_id}/rotate-secret` → `Mail.WebhookEndpointWithSecret`

Rotate the signing secret. The new one is returned once.

For `grace_hours` (default 24) the previous secret keeps signing too: `webhook-signature` then lists one `v1,` signature per secret, so receivers can switch over without dropping a delivery.

- Params: `Mail.WebhookEndpointRotateSecretParams`
- Idempotent: an `Idempotency-Key` is sent automatically and reused on retries

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |

| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND`, `WEBHOOK_ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND` | No such endpoint here (`WEBHOOK_ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND`). |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`, `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` | Idempotency-Key reused with a different body (`IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`). Idempotency: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` when this `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route; `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` while another request with the same key is still running (retry after `Retry-After` seconds, with the same key). |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const webhookEndpointWithSecret = await mail.webhooks.endpoints.rotateSecret("3f0c1a2b-4c5d-4e6f-8a9b-0c1d2e3f4a5b", { grace_hours: 24 });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/mail/api-reference#post-v1-workspaces-workspace-id-webhooks-endpoints-endpoint-id-rotate-secret)

### `mail.webhooks.endpoints.test(endpointId, params, options?)`

`POST /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/webhooks/endpoints/{endpoint_id}/test` → `Mail.WebhookDeliveryAttempt`

Send a test event to this endpoint now and return the result.

Delivers the catalogue example of `event_type`, signed like any delivery, with `"test": true` in the body. Works while the endpoint is switched off or not subscribed to that type, is logged in the event log, and is never retried or counted toward an automatic disable. Waits up to 15 s for your receiver.

| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND`, `WEBHOOK_ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND` | No such endpoint here (`WEBHOOK_ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND`). |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`, `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` | Idempotency-Key reused with a different body (`IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`). Idempotency: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` when this `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route; `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` while another request with the same key is still running (retry after `Retry-After` seconds, with the same key). |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const webhookDeliveryAttempt = await mail.webhooks.endpoints.test("3f0c1a2b-4c5d-4e6f-8a9b-0c1d2e3f4a5b", { event_type: "email.sent" });
```

Idempotency: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` when this `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route; `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` while another request with the same key is still running (retry after `Retry-After` seconds, with the same key). |

| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const webhookEndpoint = await mail.webhooks.endpoints.update("3f0c1a2b-4c5d-4e6f-8a9b-0c1d2e3f4a5b", { description: "Production receiver" });
```

### `mail.webhooks.events.replay(eventId, params?, options?)`

`POST /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/webhooks/events/{event_id}/replay` → `Mail.ReplayWebhookEvent`

Send a logged event again, to its endpoints or to one endpoint.

Same body and `webhook-id`, freshly signed, to every switched-on endpoint that receives this event type now, or only to `endpoint_id`. Waits for the receivers (up to 15 s each) and returns the attempts. A success cancels a retry still queued for that endpoint.

- Params: `Mail.WebhookEventReplayParams`
- Idempotent: an `Idempotency-Key` is sent automatically and reused on retries

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | `event_id` is not `evt_<uuid>`, or `endpoint_id` is not a UUID. |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing, expired or invalid bearer token. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | The caller lacks the action this route requires on the resource, or Mail is not enabled for the workspace. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND`, `WEBHOOK_EVENT_NOT_FOUND`, `WEBHOOK_ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND` | No such event here (`WEBHOOK_EVENT_NOT_FOUND`); events are kept for 30 days. Or No such endpoint here (`WEBHOOK_ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND`). |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT`, `WEBHOOK_ENDPOINT_NOT_SUBSCRIBED`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`, `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` | `endpoint_id` is switched off or does not receive this event type (`WEBHOOK_ENDPOINT_NOT_SUBSCRIBED`), or Idempotency-Key reused with a different body (`IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`). Idempotency: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` when this `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route; `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` while another request with the same key is still running (retry after `Retry-After` seconds, with the same key). |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const replayWebhookEvent = await mail.webhooks.events.replay("event");
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/mail/api-reference#post-v1-workspaces-workspace-id-webhooks-events-event-id-replay)
